eyebrow: The only level that closes every gap

steps.label: PHANTOM READ
steps.sub: prevented -- the one level that gets here

eyebrow: How: range locks, not just row locks
code:
-- Locks the WHOLE GAP a predicate describes --
-- the span ListPrice BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 itself,
-- not just the rows that match right now.
-- Session B's INSERT of 799.00 would be BLOCKED.
caption: This is the mechanism REPEATABLE READ simply doesn't have.

eyebrow: The cost: the most blocking of any level
code:
-- Range locks can block entirely NEW inserts,
-- not just updates to rows that already exist.
-- Reach for SERIALIZABLE only when a phantom
-- would genuinely break the business logic.
caption: The strictest point on the dial -- use it deliberately, not by default.

subtitle: A completely different approach: row versioning, not locking.
